motion_source_license: Original keyframes generated by bench-press/animate_bench_press.py in this repository. No third-party motion data, no motion capture, no generated video.

exercise_phases.name: Setup
cues: Head, upper back and glutes on the bench, both feet flat on the floor
Shoulder blades pulled back and down
Closed, pronated grip, hands evenly spaced

exercise_phases.name: Unrack
cues: Lift the bar off the rests with straight arms
Bring it over the shoulders without losing the shoulder position

exercise_phases.name: Starting position
cues: Arms straight, bar over the shoulder joints

exercise_phases.name: Eccentric (lowering)
cues: Lower the bar under control to the lower chest
Elbows travel down and slightly towards the body, not straight out to the sides

exercise_phases.name: Bottom position
cues: Bar touches the chest lightly, no bounce
Glutes and shoulders stay on the bench

exercise_phases.name: Concentric (pressing)
cues: Press the bar up and back towards the shoulders
Keep the wrists straight and the feet planted

exercise_phases.name: Lockout
cues: Elbows fully extended, bar over the shoulders

exercise_phases.name: Finish (re-rack)
cues: Move the bar back to the uprights with straight arms
Lower it into the rests under control

loop_segment.comment: One repetition that starts and ends in the same pose; used for looping clips.

technique.comment: Parameters of this provisional demonstration. Each one cites reference_notes.json; none is a universal 'correct' value and reasonable lifters differ in all of them.

placement.comment: Where the lifter lies on the bench: distance from the head end of the pad to the top of the head.

validation_profile.comment: Thresholds for automated checks. They catch defects in the animation data (jumps, slides, penetration, asymmetry). They do not certify exercise technique; that needs a qualified human.

technical_cues: Five points of contact: head, upper back and glutes on the bench, both feet on the floor
Grip the bar evenly with a closed grip, wider than shoulder width
Lower the bar under control to the lower chest
Keep the forearms vertical and the wrists over the elbows
Press until the elbows are extended, with the bar over the shoulders
common_mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
Lifting the glutes off the bench
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides
Uneven grip or one side of the bar leading
Feet moving or lifting during the repetition
